research_focus: Active semantic SLAM, robot perception, navigation, and learning
bio_html:
I am a Ph.D. candidate in the School of Information Science at the Japan Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (JAIST). I work at the Robotics Laboratory, advised by Prof. Nak Young Chong, on 3D active semantic SLAM.

I received my master's degree in Information Science from JAIST, Japan, and my B.S. degree in Robotics Engineering from the University of Engineering and Technology, Vietnam National University. My master's work focused on real-time semantic-aware simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs).

During my master's studies, I collaborated with Prof. Xiem HoangVan, Prof. Armagan Elibol, Prof. Manh Duong Phung, and Prof. Van-Truong Nguyen.

I am also a lecturer in the Robotics Department at the University of Engineering and Technology, Vietnam National University. In 2026, my visiting research at the University of Genoa focuses on the SOLARIS project with Prof. Antonio Sgorbissa, developing drone teams for solar-panel monitoring.

news.html: Our paper BPDA-GMM: Bayesian Probabilistic Data Association via Gaussian Mixture Models for Semantic SLAM has been accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L).
Our paper Semantic Visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping: A survey on state of the art, challenges, and future directions has been accepted for publication in Robotics and Autonomous Systems.
Our paper SR-SLAM: Scene reliability-based RGB-D SLAM in diverse environments has been accepted for publication in Robotics and Autonomous Systems.
I am honored to receive the JSPS Fellowship from the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science for 2027–2029.
I am honored to receive the KDDI Foundation Scholarship for 2027–2028, following its support for 2024–2025.
I am honored to receive the UniGe Scholarship from the University of Genoa for 2026.
Our paper on IRAF-SLAM: An Illumination-Robust and Adaptive Feature-Culling Front-End for Visual SLAM in Challenging Environments has been accepted to European Conference on Mobile Robots (ECMR2025).

Our paper on ESRPCB: An Edge-Guided Super-Resolution Model and Ensemble Learning for Tiny Printed Circuit Board Defect Detection has been accepted to Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence (EAAI).
Our paper on Adaptive Prior Scene-Object SLAM for Dynamic Environments has been accepted to The 2025 IEEE International Conference on Real-time Computing and Robotics.
Our paper on Context-aware LLM-based Human-Robot Interaction has been accepted to International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Networks 2025.
I am honored to receive JST SPRING Scholarship 🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉
I am honored to receive KDDI Foundation Scholarship 🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉

Our paper on M-Calib: A Monocular 3D Object Localization using 2D Estimates for Industrial Robot Vision System has been accepted to Journal of Automation, Mobile Robotics and Intelligent Systems (JAMRIS).
I served as a teaching assistant for I116E: Fundamentals of Programming.
I started my Ph.D. journey in the School of Information Science at JAIST.
Our paper on Design of Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Traffic Signal Control at Three-way Crossroads has been accepted to Public Transport.
Our paper on Enhancing Social Robot Navigation with Integrated Motion Prediction and Trajectory Planning in Dynamic Human Environments has been accepted to ICCAS2024.
Our paper on Toward Integrating Semantic-aware Path Planning and Reliable Localization for UAV Operations has been accepted to ICCAS2024.

Our paper on Optimal design and fabrication of frame structure for dual-arm service robots: An effective approach for human–robot interaction has been published in Engineering Science and Technology, an International Journal (JESTECH).
I have passed my qualifying exam and advanced to Ph.D. candidacy. 🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉
I successfully defended my M.Sc. thesis.

I am honored to receive VINIF Scholarship

I am honored to receive Collaboration Scholarship from JAIST

I successfully defended my B.S. thesis.

service_html:
I review for journals and conferences in robotics, artificial intelligence, and engineering.

  • IEEE: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters, IEEE Transactions on Robotics, IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering, and IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation & Measurement.
  • Elsevier: Knowledge-Based Systems, Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence, ISA Transactions, Expert Systems with Applications, Engineering Science and Technology, an International Journal, Computers & Electrical Engineering, Applied Soft Computing Journal, Neurocomputing, Robotics and Autonomous Systems, Measurement, and Results in Engineering.
  • Springer: Multimedia Tools and Applications.
  • Nature: Scientific Reports.
  • Other journals and conferences: ICCAIS 2023, ICCAIS 2024, ICCAS 2024, ICCAS 2025, IEEE SIMPAR 2025, All Life, and Journal of Automation, Mobile Robotics and Intelligent Systems.
